response.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT city_id, address_count,
         address_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_count DESC) AS count_rank
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT city_id, address_count, fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE count_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC, city_id;

assumptions.assumption: The top 10 cities are selected by address count, with ties at the 10th-place count included; fraction has the same ordering because every city uses the same total-address denominator.
